revision.comment: 各国の式内社表の掲載。ただし、式内比定社は現在名神大社のみの状態、国史見在社・式外社も未掲載の状態。
revision.text:
'''備後国の式内社一覧'''（びんごのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[備後国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、小社17座17社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[安那郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''多祁伊奈太伎佐耶布都神社'''||タケイナタキサヤフツノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''天別豊姫神社'''||アマワケトヨヒメノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[深津郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''須佐能袁能神社'''||スサノヲノノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[奴可郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''迩比都売神社'''||ニヒツヒメノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[沼隈郡]]''' 3座（並小） |- |'''高諸神社'''||タカモロノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''沼名前神社'''||ヌナサキノ
ヌナクマ||小|||||||||| |- |'''比古佐須伎神社'''||ヒコサスキノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[品治郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''多理比理神社'''||タリヒリノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[芦田郡|葦田郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''賀武奈備神社'''||カムナヒノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''国高依彦神社'''||クニタカヨリヒコノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甲奴郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''意加美神社'''||オカミノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[三上郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''蘇羅比古神社'''||ソラヒコノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[恵蘇郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''多加意加美神社'''||タカオ-||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[御調郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''賀羅加波神社'''||カラカハノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[世羅郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''和理比売神社'''||ワリヒメノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[三谿郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''知波夜比古神社'''||チハヤヒコノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[三次郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''知波夜比売神社'''||チハヤヒメノ||小|||||||||| |} {{-}} {{節stub}} == 式外社 == 当時すでに存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社。 === 国史見在社 === [[六国史]]に記載のある式外社。 {{節stub}} === その他 === 国史見在社以外の式外社。 {{節stub}} == 参考文献 == * 皇典講究所・全国神職会校訂[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年） - 近代デジタルライブラリー * [http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1273537 『延喜式 第2』]（日本古典全集刊行会、昭和4年） - 近代デジタルライブラリー == 外部リンク == * [http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjastate48.html 備後国 式内社17座]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」） {{式内社一覧}} [[Category:備後国の式内社|*]]

2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。

ヌナクマ||小|||||||||| |- |'''比古佐須伎神社'''||ヒコサスキノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[品治郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''多理比理神社'''||タリヒリノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[芦田郡|葦田郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''賀武奈備神社'''||カムナヒノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''国高依彦神社'''||クニタカヨリヒコノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甲奴郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''意加美神社'''||オカミノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[三上郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''蘇羅比古神社'''||ソラヒコノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[恵蘇郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''多加意加美神社'''||タカオ-||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[御調郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''賀羅加波神社'''||カラカハノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[世羅郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''和理比売神社'''||ワリヒメノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[三谿郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''知波夜比古神社'''||チハヤヒコノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[三次郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''知波夜比売神社'''||チハヤヒメノ||小|||||||||| |} == 式外社 == {{節stub}} 『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが、同帳に記載の無い神社。 == 参考文献 == * 皇典講究所・全国神職会校訂[{{NDLDC|1442211/160}} 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年） - 国立国会図書館デジタルコレクション * [{{NDLDC|1273537/37}} 『延喜式 第2』]（日本古典全集刊行会、昭和4年） - 国立国会図書館デジタルコレクション == 外部リンク == * [http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjastate48.html 備後国 式内社17座] - 國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」 {{式内社一覧}} {{DEFAULTSORT:ひんこのくにのしきないしやいちらん}} [[Category:備後国の式内社|*]] [[Category:式内社の一覧]]

ヌナクマ||小|||||||||| |- |'''比古佐須伎神社'''||ヒコサスキノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[品治郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''多理比理神社'''||タリヒリノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[芦田郡|葦田郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''賀武奈備神社'''||カムナヒノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''国高依彦神社'''||クニタカヨリヒコノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[甲奴郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''意加美神社'''||オカミノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[三上郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''蘇羅比古神社'''||ソラヒコノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[恵蘇郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''多加意加美神社'''||タカオ-||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[御調郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''賀羅加波神社'''||カラカハノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[世羅郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''和理比売神社'''||ワリヒメノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[三谿郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''知波夜比古神社'''||チハヤヒコノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[三次郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''知波夜比売神社'''||チハヤヒメノ||小|||||||||| |} == 式外社 == {{節stub}} 『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが、同帳に記載の無い神社。 == 参考文献 == * 皇典講究所・全国神職会校訂[{{NDLDC|1442211/160}} 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年） - 国立国会図書館デジタルコレクション * [{{NDLDC|1273537/37}} 『延喜式 第2』]（日本古典全集刊行会、昭和4年） - 国立国会図書館デジタルコレクション == 外部リンク == * [http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjastate48.html 備後国 式内社17座] - 國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」 {{式内社一覧}} {{DEFAULTSORT:ひんこのくにのしきないしやいちらん}} [[Category:備後国の式内社|*]] [[Category:式内社の一覧]]

'''備後国の式内社一覧'''（びんごのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[備後国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 == 式内社 == {{節stub}} 『延喜式』神名帳では、小社17座17社を記載。 {{式内社一覧/凡例}} {{式内社一覧/header}} |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[安那郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |rowspan=2|'''多祁伊奈太伎佐耶布都神社'''||rowspan=2|タケイナタキサヤフツノ||rowspan=2|小||rowspan=2| ||（論）多祁伊奈太岐佐耶布都神社||[[広島県]][[福山市]]山野町上原谷||||rowspan=2| |- |（論）二宮神社||広島県福山市神辺町八尋|| |- |'''天別豊姫神社'''||アマワケトヨヒメノ||小||||[[天別豊姫神社]]||広島県福山市神辺町川北|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[深津郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |rowspan=3|'''須佐能袁能神社'''||rowspan=3|スサノヲノノ||rowspan=3|小||rowspan=3| ||（論）[[素盞嗚神社 (福山市新市町戸手)|素盞嗚神社]]||広島県福山市新市町戸手||||rowspan=3| |- |（論）天神社||広島県福山市蔵王町天神前|| |- |（論）素盞嗚神社||広島県福山市神辺町上御領|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[奴可郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''迩比都売神社'''||ニヒツヒメノ||小||||迩比都賣神社||広島県[[庄原市]]西城町西城|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[沼隈郡]]''' 3座（並小） |- |'''高諸神社'''||タカモロノ||小||||高諸神社||広島県福山市今津町|||| |- |'''沼名前神社'''||ヌナサキノ

In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein – the so‑called {{ill|Shikigai‑sha|de|Shikigai‑sha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}} – (Exception if another comment explains a different case) {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle|12=draft}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle|12=draft}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province''' (備後国の式内社一覧) is a list of Shinto shrines – namely the so‑called {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}} and their {{ill|Candidate Shrines|de|Candidate Shrines|ja|論社|zh|候補神社|12=draft}} – recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “Kamimyōchō Jōge” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}} ({{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}), which are classified as being located in {{ill|Bingo Province|de|Bingo-Provinz|ja|備後国|zh|備後国|12=draft}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein – the so‑called {{ill|Shikigai‑sha|de|Shikigai‑sha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}} – (Exception if another comment explains a different case) {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle|12=draft}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle|12=draft}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province''' (備後国の式内社一覧) is a list of Shinto shrines – namely the so‑called {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|zh|式内社|12=draft}} and their {{ill|Candidate Shrines|de|Candidate Shrines|ja|論社|zh|候補神社|12=draft}} – recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “Kamimyōchō Jōge” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|Engishiki|zh|Engishiki|12=draft}} ({{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}), which are classified as being located in {{ill|Bingo Province|de|Bingo-Provinz|ja|備後国|zh|備後国|12=draft}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein – the so‑called {{ill|Shikigai‑sha|de|Shikigai‑sha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}} – In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein – the so‑called {{ill|Shikigai‑sha|de|Shikigai‑sha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}} – In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein – the so‑called {{ill|Shikigai‑sha|de|Shikigai‑sha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社|12=draft}} – [[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Bingo Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Bingo Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. Or the list of shrines in Bingo Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Bingo Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Bingo Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Bingo Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Bingo Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Bingo Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Bingo Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Bingo Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Bingo Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Bingo Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. revision.text:
[[Category:Shikinaisha top]] [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Bingo Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Bingo Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ '''備後国の式内社一覧'''（びんごのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[備後国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 == 式内社 == {{節stub}} 『延喜式』神名帳では、小社17座17社を記載。 {{式内社一覧/凡例}} {{式内社一覧/header}} |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[安那郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |rowspan=2|'''多祁伊奈太伎佐耶布都神社'''||rowspan=2|タケイナタキサヤフツノ||rowspan=2|小||rowspan=2| ||（論）多祁伊奈太岐佐耶布都神社||[[広島県]][[福山市]]山野町上原谷||||rowspan=2| |- |（論）二宮神社||広島県福山市神辺町八尋|| |- |'''天別豊姫神社'''||アマワケトヨヒメノ||小||||[[天別豊姫神社]]||広島県福山市神辺町川北|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[深津郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |rowspan=3|'''須佐能袁能神社'''||rowspan=3|スサノヲノノ||rowspan=3|小||rowspan=3| ||（論）[[素盞嗚神社 (福山市新市町戸手)|素盞嗚神社]]||広島県福山市新市町戸手||||rowspan=3| |- |（論）天神社||広島県福山市蔵王町天神前|| |- |（論）素盞嗚神社||広島県福山市神辺町上御領|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[奴可郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''迩比都売神社'''||ニヒツヒメノ||小||||迩比都賣神社||広島県[[庄原市]]西城町西城|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[沼隈郡]]''' 3座（並小） |- |'''高諸神社'''||タカモロノ||小||||高諸神社||広島県福山市今津町|||| |- |'''沼名前神社'''||ヌナサキノ

[[Category:Shikinaisha top]] [[Category:Shikinaisha top]] This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō, 17 groups comprising 17 small shrines are recorded. {{List of This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō, 17 groups comprising 17 small shrines are recorded. {{List of revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō, 17 groups comprising 17 small shrines are recorded. {{List of This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō, 17 groups comprising 17 small shrines are recorded. {{List of revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō, 17 groups comprising 17 small shrines are recorded. {{List of revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō, 17 groups comprising 17 small shrines are recorded. {{List of revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō, 17 groups comprising 17 small shrines are recorded. {{List of revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō, 17 groups comprising 17 small shrines are recorded. {{List of This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == {{section stub}} In the ‘Engishiki’ Jinmyōchō, 17 groups comprising 17 small shrines are recorded. {{List of This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:04, 4 July 2025 (UTC)}} This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Bingo Province''' or the list of shrines in [[Bingo Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}
On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[Bingo Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the Engishiki list. They are shown in a separate table to avoid confusion.
The {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}} counts 17 {{ill|Shikinaisha|WD=Q134917286}} in the province – 17 {{ill|Shikinai Shosha|WD=Q134917287}} and 0 {{ill|Shikinai Taisha|WD=Q134917288}}.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shosha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shosha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Bingo Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shosha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shosha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Bingo Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shosha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Bingo Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shosha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Bingo Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shosha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Bingo Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shōsha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Bingo Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shōsha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Bingo Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shōsha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shosha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Bingo Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 17 Shikinaisha in the province – 17 Shikinai Shosha and 0 Shikinai Taisha.
